messages:
jana: Billing ops spotted spike in 'org-unknown' yesterday. traced to sidecar not attaching X-Org-Id when proxied via edge-rewrite.
mike: any logs?
jana: yes, staging repro: 
```
WARN sidecar: auth-exchange failed err=ERR_EXCHANGE_TIMEOUT deadline=50ms
route: edge->sidecar(rewrite)
```
so we drop org claim.
kai: sidecar timeout is 50ms with no retries. multi-hop can blow that.
mike: options: raise timeout (p99 risk) or fallback locally. prefer best-effort local decode + cache then mark low confidence.
jana: proposal: 1) try cached token-hash->org, 2) local JWT decode for stable claims, 3) if fail, set X-Attribution=unattributed and X-Attribution-Source=fallback_unattributed. emit metric for reason.
infra-bot: note: edge adds ~8ms when double-proxying auth calls.
kai: telemetry needed: auth.sidecar.exchange.{success,timeout,4xx}, auth.sidecar.decode.local_success, auth.sidecar.attribution.fallback with tags env,route,org.
mike: console UX: add "Attribution Confidence" pill on org usage card. tooltip shows split by source.
jana: rollout: canary flag FEATURE_SIDECAR_EXCHANGE_RETRIES=2 for 5% canary orgs, then ramp. config snippet in PR.
infra-bot: deploy started svc-sidecar@canary by jana (build a1b2c).
jana: PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sidecar/pull/299 - retry + fallback + metrics. ping @mike @kai for review.
infra-bot: deploy success svc-sidecar@canary a1b2c -> 6/6 healthy
jana: 30m canary: exchange.timeout=60 (0.07%), attribution.fallback=12 (0.014%). increasing trace sampling for fallbacks.
kai: add alert if fallback rate >0.5% over 5m. also file ENG tickets for console pill and billing tag.
mike: small policy: don't retry on 4xx from auth-service. only retry on timeouts/5xx.
jana: will add unit tests for decode fallback and ensure no token values in logs. :thumbsup:
